items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I did not understand the Lou Waters band at all, and it was hard for me to grasp.

ctx.x: In respect to me, there was no return address on those oranges, just said Woody Herman. So I just ate the oranges.
But I wasn't playing Woody Herman records. I didn't even -- this was another place where we fell out. I did not want to play the Lou Waters records.
Who wanted you to play the Lou --
